title: 404 responses have an empty body rather than a JSON error
evidence: Program.cs:12,24,27 return Results.NotFound() with no payload; 400s use ValidationProblem (problem+json)
suggestion: Return Results.NotFound(new { error = "Book not found" }) or a ProblemDetails so every response is JSON

title: year and isbn are not validated
evidence: Program.cs:30-36 Validate() checks only Title and Author; any int year (e.g. negative) and any isbn string are accepted
suggestion: Optionally range-check year and format-check isbn

title: Agent could not run its own tests inside its sandbox (local sockets blocked); harness scoring ran them successfully
evidence: _agent_stdout.log: `dotnet test tests/Books.Tests.csproj --no-restore` ... failed; final message asks to run tests 'in an environment that permits local sockets'; scores.json defect_rate=1.0
suggestion: Harness note: codex sandbox blocks sockets used by dotnet test/MSBuild node reuse; consider allowing local sockets so the agent can self-verify
